import argparse,concurrent.futures,json,os,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'scripts'))
from durable_records import write_json
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--device',required=True);a=p.parse_args()
base_dir=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
out=base_dir/('qualify-'+a.device.replace(':','-'));out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
base=os.environ.copy();base.update(TIDE_BUILD_DIR=str(base_dir/'build-native'),TIDE_DENSE_NUMERIC_REPORT=str(out/'numeric'))
if a.device!='cpu':base.update({k:a.device for k in ('TIDE_WINDOW_DEVICE','TIDE_DENSE_DEVICE','TIDE_LAYER_DEVICE','TIDE_FC_DEVICE','TIDE_DESCRIBE_DEVICE')})
records=[]
def invoke(name,command,env=None,limit=600):
    command=list(map(str,command));start=time.monotonic()
    with (out/(name+'.log')).open('x') as log:
        try:code=subprocess.run(command,env=env or base,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=limit).returncode
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:code=124
    row=dict(name=name,command=command,exit_code=code,seconds=time.monotonic()-start)
    print(json.dumps(row),flush=True);return row

def save(row):records.append(row);write_json(out/'commands.json',records)

def tests(name,files,dtype):
    command=[sys.executable,'-m','pytest'] if a.device=='cpu' else [sys.executable,'-c',"from tidegraph.runtime import resolve_device; resolve_device('npu:0'); import pytest,sys; sys.exit(pytest.main(sys.argv[1:]))"]
    return invoke(name,[*command,'-q',*files,'--dtype',dtype,'--tb=short','--junitxml='+str(out/(name+'.xml'))])
if a.device=='cpu':
    scopes=[('block-roots',['tests/test_block_attention.py','tests/test_kv_block_query.py','tests/test_bank_attention.py','tests/test_query_roots.py','tests/test_kv_prefix_roots.py','tests/test_independent_copies.py']),
      ('state-training',['tests/test_kv_sequence_vjp.py','tests/test_selected_boundary_execution.py','tests/test_weighted_describe_training.py','tests/test_snapshot_bank.py']),
      ('queries-diagnostics',['tests/test_weighted_query_vjp.py','tests/test_weighted_dense_query.py','tests/test_weighted_describe_capability.py','tests/test_fc_comparison_diagnostics.py','tests/test_fc_tensor_baseline.py','tests/test_cost_comparison.py']),
      ('general',['tests/test_component_window.py','tests/test_component_window_weighted.py','tests/test_settle_ports.py','tests/test_native_settle.py'])]
    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
        futures=[pool.submit(tests,name,files,'both') for name,files in scopes]
        for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures):save(future.result())
else:
    save(tests('blocks-device',['tests/test_kv_block_query.py','tests/test_bank_attention.py','tests/test_snapshot_bank.py','tests/test_fc_tensor_baseline.py','tests/test_layer_tensor_baseline.py'],'float32'))
installed=base|{'PYTHONPATH':''}
for client in ('python','native'):
    save(invoke('consumer-'+client,[sys.executable,'examples/consumer_core5/dense_query.py','--device',a.device,
        '--client',client,'--dtype','float64' if a.device=='cpu' else 'float32','--native-library',base_dir/'build-native',
        '--no-trace','--output-dir',out/('consumer-'+client)],installed))
sdk=base|dict(LD_LIBRARY_PATH=(base_dir/'sdk-library-path.txt').read_text(),PYTHONPATH='')
for mode in ('complete','outputs'):
    save(invoke('sdk-'+mode,['/usr/bin/python3','scripts/check_query_sdk.py','--binary',base_dir/'sdk/client/weighted-benchmark',
        '--fixture',base_dir/'sdk-fixture.json','--device',a.device,'--dtype','float64' if a.device=='cpu' else 'float32',
        '--return-mode',mode,'--output-dir',out/('sdk-'+mode)],sdk))
raise SystemExit(int(any(r['exit_code'] for r in records)))
